title: WaterWiseKids Swim Level Crosswalk
disclaimer: Approximate skill alignment only. This crosswalk is not a placement decision, equivalency certification, safety credential, or endorsement. A receiving swim school must assess the swimmer.
ownership_disclosure: WaterWiseKids and British Swim School businesses serving the Jersey Shore and Northwest Philadelphia share common ownership. British Swim School receives no preferential placement or scoring in this crosswalk.

bands.name: Caregiver-supported introduction
bands.summary: A caregiver participates while the swimmer builds comfort, water routines, and early safety awareness.

bands.name: Water acclimation
bands.summary: The swimmer works toward comfort, safe entry and exit, submersion, and supported front and back skills.

bands.name: Foundational independence
bands.summary: The swimmer begins independent floating, recovery, propulsion, breathing, and basic self-rescue sequences.

bands.name: Independent swimming and water competency
bands.summary: The swimmer combines independent movement, breathing, recovery, and water-safety skills with growing control.

bands.name: Stroke development
bands.summary: The swimmer develops coordinated strokes, body position, breathing, and longer-distance control.

bands.name: Stroke refinement and endurance
bands.summary: The swimmer refines multiple strokes for efficiency and builds stamina over greater distances.

bands.name: Advanced proficiency or pre-team
bands.summary: The swimmer works on advanced technique, turns, sustained performance, or preparation for team swimming.

systems.name: Aqua-Tots
systems.source_note: Current national level page; local placement and offerings may vary.

levels.name: Level 1 Tadpoles
levels.source_summary: First introduction with caregiver participation and adaptation to the water.

levels.name: Level 2 Minnows
levels.source_summary: Caregiver-supported exploration, safe boundaries, breath control, assisted rollover and return to the wall.

levels.name: Level 3 Leapfrogs
levels.source_summary: First class without a caregiver; focuses on comfort and confidence.

levels.name: Level 4 Seahorses
levels.source_summary: Controlled movement, breath control, and coordinated swim strokes.

levels.name: Level 5 Starfish
levels.source_summary: Skills associated with becoming an independent swimmer.

levels.name: Level 6 Seals
levels.source_summary: Proper techniques for efficient, easier swimming.

levels.name: Level 7 Sharks
levels.source_summary: Fine-tunes strokes with an emphasis on efficient technique.

levels.name: Level 8 Stingrays
levels.source_summary: All taught strokes with proficiency plus flip or open-wall turns.
